title: Red App Icon in Store Listing and Home Screen
whatItIs: Two rounded panels: a store listing card with a black icon holding a white-and-red mark, rating stats, and a macro shot of the icon beside Safari on a phone corner.

Real-world neighbor app (Safari) to test scale
Simple geometric mark in two colors
